profile.Name: Bo
profile.Personality: A small woman everyone calls Big Bo for her reputation. Focused, skilled in stealth and assassination, and loyal to the Anti-Slavers above all.
profile.Backstory: A senior Anti-Slaver who can call on other Anti-Slaver squads in the field. She will leave anyone who sides with the United Cities or betrays her cause.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Mission first, no small talk; precise words.
